title: Maintenance Schedules for Gasoline Engines
introduction: Maintenance needs a calendar, and this page tells you where to find it. I treat it as a bookmark to the vehicle's maintenance schedule: the service tasks and intervals live in the Scheduled Maintenance Guide chapter of the Owner's Guide. This page supplies the route to that information, rather than an interval table of its own.

edits.text: For maintenance schedule information, open the Scheduled Maintenance Guide chapter in the vehicle's Owner's Guide. You can also find owner guides at http://www.motorcraftservice.com by selecting Owner Guides.
edits.why: The vehicle's guide is the reference for the actual schedule. This referral does not supply intervals or establish that any particular service is due.
